dialogues.speaker: Xbalanque
dialogues.text: Playing with this stuff is part of everyday life, then?

dialogues.speaker: Xbalanque
dialogues.text: Ah, I wonder if I would've ever become Pyro Archon if we had had these gadgets around back then. I might've had too a bit much fun with them...

dialogues.speaker: Xbalanque
dialogues.text: Agreed! Good thing they were only invented after I died, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Hahaha, looks like I really am better after all, for becoming Pyro Archon even with all this temptation around.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: The hands of our friends at the Children of Echoes are as skilled as ever. They were already famed in your era, right? This bike was built by their most talented artisan in this age.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, we just passed them by.
